claims.evidence: The witness report notes dirt on tires but cannot confirm the duration of storage.
The seller's own statement that the bike has not been used for 3 years makes a 6-month ownership impossible.
The witness report explicitly states these were not shown or tested.
Photo 0 shows the bike but is not detailed enough to confirm the absence of rust on the chain or bolts.
The witness cannot verify component specifications against factory standards.

risks.risk: Seized or damaged drivetrain from long-term storage.
risks.proof: A video showing the pedals being turned and the chain moving through all gears.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring a full drivetrain replacement.

risks.risk: Structural frame failure (cracks or hidden welds).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the head tube, bottom bracket, and seat stay welds.
A video of the bike being pushed and the brakes being applied to a full stop.
risks.if_unproven: As needing a complete brake overhaul.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tire sidewalls showing texture and any cracking.
risks.if_unproven: As needing immediate tire and tube replacement.

proof_requests: Video of the gears shifting while the rear wheel is elevated.
Video of the brakes being engaged while the bike is in motion.
Close-up photos of the chain, cassette, and derailleur to check for rust.
Close-up photos of the frame joints/welds.
response.reason: The seller provides two mutually exclusive timelines, claiming the bike was bought 6 months ago while also stating it has been unused for 3 years. This logical contradiction suggests the seller's claims are unreliable or the item's history is being falsified.
